title: Apollo 17 insectoid metallic probe in lunar sky (unreleased)

tellings.quote: If you brighten the image a little bit, you see that it almost looks like an insecttoid type probe like metallic bluish metallic object.

plain: A photo from Apollo 17, the 1972 Moon landing of astronauts Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt, is said to show a bluish metallic object in the lunar sky that looks like an insect-shaped probe once the image is brightened. The researcher Maaneli Derakhshani describes this to Michels from his own look at NASA's public Apollo image archives. If he is right, something unexplained was flying near the astronauts on the Moon.
